name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 3-pixel solid focus ring with a 3-pixel outer glow in the brand color for interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users see clear focus without sacrificing contrast or visual noise. The trade-off is slightly more CSS complexity, but it’s worth it for universal clarity.

name: Reader
text: Risk: The 3px ring + 3px glow creates a "halo effect" that can obscure adjacent elements, especially on dense screens. Better: Use a 2px ring with a 2px outer glow at 30% opacity—still visible but less intrusive. Settle it: Test with a 10-person keyboard-only group; if any fail to track focus or report overlap, drop the glow.
